name: @djgrant/hn/item
description: A Hacker News story page: the story plus a page of its comment thread as a tree. HN serves the whole thread in one document, so the lens rebuilds reply nesting from row indentation and windows the top-level comments client-side (default 30/page); next_page is the same lens at the next window (null on the last page). Pass params {page, limit} to control the window.

resolve.post: ($all := [$[text != null]]; $size := $number($limit ? $limit : 30); $pg := $number($page ? $page : 1); $start := ($pg - 1) * $size; $build := function($rows) { ($n := $count($rows); $n = 0 ? [] : ($top := $number($rows[0].indent); $starts := [$filter([0..$n-1], function($j) { $number($rows[$j].indent) = $top })]; $map($starts, function($s, $k) { ($next := $k < $count($starts) - 1 ? $starts[$k + 1] : $n; $row := $rows[$s]; { "author": $row.author, "age": $row.age, "text": $row.text, "replies": [$build([$rows#$j[$j > $s and $j < $next]])] }) }))) }; $tree := [$build($all)]; { "story": { "id": $id }, "comments": [$tree#$i[$i >= $start and $i < $start + $size]], "next_page": ($count($tree) > $start + $size) ? "https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=" & $id & "&p=" & ($pg + 1) : null })

resolve.prompt: This is a Hacker News story page. Return {story: {title, url, score}, comments: [{author, age, text, replies}], next_page}. Comments nest: each comment's replies is an array of the same {author, age, text, replies} shape (use [] when a comment has no replies); use the indentation of each comment row to decide nesting. Return at most 30 top-level comments in reading order. If you can see more than 30 top-level comments on the page, set next_page to the URL of this page with the query param &p=2 appended (page 2 of the client-side window); otherwise set next_page to null. Include only fields you can actually see.
